session_summary: As a first-time player, I successfully completed the Moss Trail route. I walked forward across 12 steps, encountered and defeated three enemies (Goblin, Slime, Kobold) along the way, and finished the route with 149 coins and full HP (100).

observations.evidence: Telemetry shows the session starting directly on the Moss Trail with walk actions and combat encounters, but there are no welcome tooltips or tutorial prompts at step 0 for a first-time player.
observations.recommendation: Implement welcome tooltips and introductory guidance for initial movement and combat mechanics.

observations.evidence: Completing Moss Trail rewarded 25 coins, bringing total currency to 149, with zero cosmetics owned.
observations.recommendation: Ensure first-time players receive a clear introductory milestone reward or overview of how coins are used in the marketplace.

feature_requests.title: Onboarding Tutorial Prompt System
feature_requests.player_value: Helps first-time players understand initial movement and combat mechanics without confusion.
feature_requests.rationale: First-time players need clear introductory prompts at step 0 to grasp how traversal and combat interact.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add introductory guidance pop-ups or text tooltips for new players starting their first route.

keep: Moss Trail route pacing and length (12 steps) feel appropriate for a beginner introduction.
Combat encounters interspersed with walking actions provide a steady rhythm.
focus: onboarding, clarity, route choice, controls, first-session friction
